title: Frontend Platform Engineer
sponsorshipEvidence: We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

eligibility.reason: The company sponsors visas to Germany, so a candidate without local work rights could be hired if based in Germany; elsewhere existing right to work is required.

mustHave.text: Built architecture-heavy frontend products such as canvas-based tools, real-time apps, or collaborative editors
Can measure, debug and improve runtime performance in large frontend applications
Strong TypeScript frontend expertise in large evolving codebases
Architectural ownership: owned frontend systems, led migrations or re-architectures
Systems thinking mindset: trade-offs, platform contracts, maintainability
Pragmatic engineering: refactoring, modularization, tech debt reduction

niceToHave.text: Experience with CRDTs, multiplayer systems or real-time communication layers
Plugin systems, extension architectures, micro-frontends or web worker orchestration
Worked on workflow engines, developer tools or infrastructure-adjacent SaaS
Built products across cloud, single-tenant or self-hosted environments
Observability mindset: instrumentation, debugging, rollout safety
